title: Harness Backlog
description: Schema for AI Dev Harness backlog files stored in .harness/backlogs/

priority.description: Processing order when multiple backlogs exist. 1 = highest priority.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the backlog was created

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this backlog

requirements_doc.description: Path to analyst requirements document, e.g. .harness/requirements/slug-requirements.md

type.description: infrastructure = demo gate skipped, coverage threshold applies; feature = demo gate required

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task moved to in_progress. Null until started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when orchestrator marked task complete. Null until done.

spec_file.description: Relative path to Gherkin feature file

demo_scenario.description: Exact Gherkin scenario name for @feature-demonstrator. Required when demo_required=true.

demo_entry_point.description: Relative path to application executable. Required when demo_required=true.

demo_launch_args.description: Command-line arguments to launch app in simulator/deterministic mode.

coverage_threshold.description: Minimum code coverage %. Required when demo_required=false (infrastructure tasks).

acceptance_criteria.description: Exact Scenario: names from the feature file. These are the immutable contract.

design_note.description: Architectural guidance for @developer. Must reference specific ADR file(s).

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be complete before this task can start.
